name: Holzer Astrid
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Holzer Astrid welcomes travellers to a sunny, quiet residential area of Mayrhofen in the upper Zillertal. Brightly and modernly furnished, this self-catering flat provides ideal living comfort for couples and families, offering a fully equipped kitchen with contemporary appliances, restful bedrooms, a sleek bathroom with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and a sunny balcony with panoramic views of the Zillertal and Tux Alps. Mayrhofen's bustling town centre, complete with bakeries, boutiques, and classic Tyrolean taverns, is just a leisurely walk away. In winter, the local ski bus quickly whisks guests to the Penkenbahn and Ahornbahn cable cars within the Mountopolis Mayrhofen ski realm. In summer, high-altitude trails and climbing routes across the nature park begin nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday flat in Mayrhofen in the Zillertal with a fully equipped kitchen, balcony, and quick access to the Penkenbahn.
